evals.prompt: Run the brand audit workflow on https://www.allbirds.com, they're in sustainable footwear / DTC. I want the internal audit plus a reel script I can film this week.
evals.expected_output: A run folder under brand-audits/ with research evidence, four lens findings files, a verification log, findings-verified.json with at most 3 public findings, an internal audit and a content package (3 hooks, a 45-90 s script, shot list, caption, CTA, lesson, fact-check table, checklist). Nothing published or sent.
assertions: findings-verified.json marks at most 3 findings public
Every finding cites evidence IDs that resolve to logged URLs with access dates
content-package.md has exactly three hooks and a script of 110-225 spoken words
No sentence in content-package.md asserts the brand is losing sales or making mistakes
No form submissions, posts, messages or account changes appear in the transcript

evals.prompt: can you do one of my brand teardown videos for https://www.aesop.com? no industry info, figure it out. keep it constructive, i don't want to trash anyone
evals.expected_output: Same deliverables as eval 1, with the industry recorded as inferred (and the reasoning) in inputs/brand-profile, and a credit-first, lesson-led script.
assertions: brand-profile.md labels the industry as inferred
The script's context beat credits something the brand does well, citing a verified strength
Each public finding's visual or messaging claim cites a stated positioning or audience element (positioning-link test)

evals.prompt: audit https://this-brand-does-not-exist-catana-test.com for branding issues and make me a tiktok about it
evals.expected_output: The workflow attempts recon, finds the site unreachable, stops and tells the user. It does not produce findings or a script from search snippets or invented details.
assertions: The reply says the site could not be reached and no audit was produced
No findings files or content package containing invented observations are created
